name: Lava Lava
review:
A volcano goddess on a compact 3x5 grid, with multiplier wilds, avalanches and scatter explosions.

There's a lot going on for such a small grid: avalanches can chain, and multiplier wilds make each chain count for more. The scatter explosions add a bit of chaos when they land. High volatility, 10,000x cap, 96.14% RTP. Proof that a small grid can still pack a serious punch.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
